title: Nina Kollars - Confessions of an Nespresso Money Mule - DEF CON 27 Conference
summary: At DEF CON 27, Nina Kollars tells how buying Nespresso capsules on eBay led her to investigate fraudsters reselling goods bought with stolen credit cards. She describes her non-technical tracking and reporting efforts.
why: HN points to it as an entertaining and informative explanation of the economics of reshipping and stolen-card resale scams.
